login.subtitle: We'll email you a code. No passwords.
login.title: Enter your *space*.

auth.legal: By continuing you accept our Terms and Privacy Policy.

totp.title: Verify your *identity*.
totp.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.lost: I don't have my phone · use a backup code

enroll.title: Set up your *second step*.
enroll.subtitle: Scan the code with your authenticator app, or open it from this phone.

backup.title: Save these *codes*.
backup.subtitle: If you lose your phone, each one lets you in once. They won't be shown again.

recover.title: Use a *backup* code.
recover.subtitle: Using it disables your previous authenticator; you'll set up a new one.
recover.noCodes: I don't have the codes either

reset.title: Request a *reset*.
reset.subtitle: We'll email you to confirm. If nobody cancels it, in 48 hours you'll be able to set up a new authenticator.
reset.waitSubtitle: You will be able to set up a new authenticator on {fecha}.

session.title: We closed your *session*.
session.subtitle: 30 minutes passed without activity. It's a security measure.

stepup.title: Confirm it's *you*.
stepup.subtitle: This action requires the code from your authenticator app.

evicted.title: It's been a *while*.
evicted.subtitle: Your phone cleared the app's saved data. Just sign in again.
